label: INFERENCE
extraction: OpenAI Agents SDK A2A protocol for cross-vendor orchestration. Before A2A, multi-agent systems required all agents to share same framework and runtime. Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol enables cross-vendor orchestration: agents from different frameworks/runtimes can interoperate. Swarms pattern (late 2024): one agent 'hands off' conversation to another via Handoff(TargetAgent). Benefit: no central manager bottleneck, conversation flows naturally between specialized entities. LangGraph remains dominant framework for state-aware hierarchical loops. Google ADK, Microsoft Agent Framework, and OpenAI Agents SDK all support orchestrator-subagent pattern natively as of 2026.
